title: Unit Event — Dear Me, From Back Then — Episode5 A Real Idol

meta.Event Outline: The time has finally arrived for the first solo show of MORE MORE JUMP! Minori still can't seem to shake her nerves, but is reminded of the time she saw an ASRUN show for the first time after Haruka tells Minori a story about her own past...

rows.Line: Minori's Room
se_event_then_2022_008

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you all so much!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: This show became the main reason why I wanted to become an idol...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It had such a huge impact on me. And after I got home...
A few years ago

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I knew it...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I guess this means I'm...)

rows.Speaker: Minori's Father
rows.Line: Minori, are you there?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huh? Mom? Dad...?
Is something the matter?

rows.Speaker: Minori's Mother
rows.Line: You've been awfully quiet despite finally getting to see ASRUN live. We're a little concerned and began wondering if something happened.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: If something happened...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
It was incredible. Really incredible...
I can't even begin to describe how amazing it was...

rows.Speaker: Minori's Mother
rows.Line: Hehe. Oh, that's good to hear.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, but...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Mom, Dad, there's something I need to talk to you both.

rows.Speaker: Minori's Father
rows.Line: What is it?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I... After going to see ASRUN live, I've decided that I seriously want to become an idol.

rows.Speaker: Minori's Mother
rows.Line: Hehe. You've been saying that for...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: This is different.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I'm serious.
Starting tomorrow... No, I'm going forward with this starting today.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
But I know it's not going to be easy.
Between auditioning and needing money, I'll be asking a lot from you both.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I know this sounds really selfish, but I'm really hoping that you'll help me with all that...

rows.Speaker: Minori's Mother
rows.Line: Minori...

rows.Speaker: Minori's Father
rows.Line: I understand how you feel...

rows.Speaker: Minori's Father
rows.Line: However, becoming an idol probably... No, it won't be easy at all...

rows.Speaker: Minori's Father
rows.Line: You're not the only one with this dream, Minori. Others all around the country are trying to become idols who shine and appear on TV.

rows.Speaker: Minori's Father
rows.Line: Only the chosen few are able to succeed in the way ASRUN has, while everyone else... They get left behind and have no other choice other than to quit.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah, I know!
It would be impossible to succeed with how I am now.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But someday...!

rows.Speaker: Minori's Father
rows.Line: There's no guarantee that “someday” will ever come. You can work hard, but may never be rewarded...

rows.Speaker: Minori's Father
rows.Line: It won't all be fun and games either. As your father, I'd really rather not see you experience that kind of pain or suffering...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
But...
But even so I... I don't want to give up...!

rows.Speaker: Minori's Father
rows.Line: Minori...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I don't want to give up before even trying. Because I'd regret that decision the most... I'd end up asking myself, “Why didn't I go through with it that time?”

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But if I fail after taking things really seriously and trying my absolute best, then I'll feel better about walking away from it...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
So, I want to do this.
I understand that my hard work may never be rewarded, Dad...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
But I want to give it a try!
I don't care how hard it's gonna be. I won't know the answer if I don't do this!

rows.Speaker: Minori's Father
rows.Line:
I see...
Then, I have no reason to argue any further.

rows.Speaker: Minori's Father
rows.Line: What you want to become in the future is ultimately up to you, Minori. So, you have my support...

rows.Speaker: Minori's Father
rows.Line: And like you said, you should start by giving it your absolute best.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Dad...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thank you so much...!
I promise to do just that!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: From that day forward, I started trying a lot of different things. That included asking for lessons after school from the dance club's teacher, strength training...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And yet, it still felt like I was missing a lot. As much as I wanted to attend a training school, the enrollment cost was just too high...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Which is why I decided to try for lots and lots of auditions while doing whatever I could to succeed...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: However, even when I managed to pass the initial screening, I ended up failing the interview that followed... After trying so hard too...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Now, I'm standing right next to Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Considering all that happened, this really does feel like a dream. Or rather, a dream come true...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: No, it hasn't fully come true yet...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: My goal is to become an amazing idol like Haruka. I want to learn how to bring people together the way she does...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Let's sing!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And give everyone hope by telling them that tomorrow will be a better day. So...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: This solo show is going to be my first step towards making that a reality.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Which is why I don't have time to be feeling nervous. Like Haruka that one time, I...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I want to give this show everything I have and make it a really special moment for everyone!
The day of the solo show
Backstage

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It's almost time...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Oh no...
Now I'm starting to get nervous...>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
<This is really it.
We'll be watching from the phones you placed in front of the stage once it starts.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<Break a leg, girls.
I hope you enjoy your very first solo show as MORE MORE JUMP!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thank you.
And we appreciate you all joining us for this.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That reminds me. Saito sent me a message earlier saying that all of the merch we prepared for today just sold out.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: R-Really?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, the towels in particular just seemed to fly off the shelves! The wristbands were the last to go, but they also sold out in the end.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
That's wonderful...!
I was actually a little worried that we'd made too many. It's good to hear that it was just the right amount.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: If anything, we probably didn't make enough. I mean, everything sold out this fast.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I feel kinda bad since some people probably couldn't get what they were after, so we'll have to rethink our inventory next time...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
But that can wait.
For now, we should be thinking about putting on a great performance.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right. All the tickets for today also sold out, so we should be expecting around 700 people... All here to see MORE MORE JUMP! perform on stage.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Let's give it everything we've got...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
So, Minori, how do you feel?
Has your nervousness reached its peak yet?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I-I'm really nervous! But I'll be fine!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I took a peek at the audience just now, and their eyes were sparkling like they're really looking forward to seeing our show...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That reminded me of how I felt as a member of the audience who was there to watch a performance.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I remember being really excited about what it was gonna be like. So excited that I sorta started feeling sick...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm sure everyone here is feeling the same thing right now.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Minori...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's why I want to do my best to give them an amazing performance! I want them to have fun and go home smiling!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
So, Haruka, let's do this!
Let's give this show everything we have!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Together...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, let's.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
You too, Airi, Shizuku!
Let's spread as much hope as we can to everyone and make this show super fun!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Let's do just that!

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line: Get ready, everyone! We're on standby!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: This is it.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: This show's gonna be a moment we're probably never gonna forget, so let's not leave anything at the door... We're giving it everything. Absolutely everything.

rows.Speaker: Minori, Haruka & Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Yes!
song00004_off_f

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: More and more songs!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: More and more energy!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: More and more hope!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: May our songs reach more, more, more people!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: MORE MORE...

rows.Speaker: Minori, Haruka, Airi & Shizuku
rows.Line: JUMP!
